description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No 61 of 1979 (Essential Public Service for the Purposes of the Community)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory action by the President that establishes legal requirements for certain services (electricity and petroleum supply), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
